ValidationRule.description: stage should be pending arrival if visa requires is yes and visa approved is true
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND(ISPICKVAL(Visa_Required__c ,'Yes'), Visa_Decision__c=TRUE, OR( TEXT(Stage__c)='Visa In Progress', TEXT(Stage__c)='Pending Student Confirmation', TEXT(Stage__c)='Application submitted to School', TEXT(Stage__c)='Preparing Application' ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Please select Pending Arrival Stage when Visa Required is yes and Visa approved is checked
